lede.zh: MiniMax-H3 在 4 张 PPU ZW810E 上完成 T2VA 与 Ref2VA。每类任务各有 10 个有效串行测量；T2VA 中位耗时 443.20 秒，Ref2VA 为 755.05 秒。
lede.en: MiniMax-H3 T2VA and Ref2VA generation on four PPU ZW810E accelerators, with ten valid serial measurements per task. Median times were 443.20 s for T2VA and 755.05 s for Ref2VA.

heading.zh: 参考条件主要增加逐步去噪时间
heading.en: Reference conditioning primarily increases denoising time

intro.zh: Ref2VA 比 T2VA 多 311.85 秒；阶段计时中去噪增加 269.63 秒。参考素材编码约 3.7 秒，并非总差值的主要来源。
intro.en: Ref2VA takes 311.85 s longer than T2VA; phase timings show 269.63 s of additional denoising. Reference-media encoding takes about 3.7 s and is not the main source of the difference.

note.zh: 这是同一硬件与引擎配置下两种任务的自测，不是跨模型权重对比。
note.en: These are two workloads measured on the same hardware and engine configuration, not a comparison across model checkpoints.

heading.zh: Ref2VA 中位耗时为 T2VA 的 1.70 倍

intro.zh: 两类任务均使用 1344×768、5 秒、124 帧、24 fps、50 步、BF16，串行并发为 1。各有 10 个有效样本。
intro.en: Both tasks used 1344×768, 5 seconds, 124 frames, 24 fps, 50 steps, BF16, and serial concurrency 1. Each has ten valid samples.

notes.en: T2VA range was 443.20–443.22 s; Ref2VA range was 755.03–755.08 s.

notes.zh: 样本量 n=10，不报告尾部分位数；极小范围只表示该次启动内测量稳定。
notes.en: At n=10, tail percentiles are omitted; the narrow range describes this startup only.

title.zh: 视频生成任务中位耗时

hint.zh: 每类任务 n=10；越低越快。
hint.en: n=10 per task; lower is faster.

heading.zh: 额外耗时主要出现在去噪循环
heading.en: Most additional time is spent in denoising

intro.zh: T2VA 去噪 384.47 秒，Ref2VA 去噪 654.10 秒；平均单步分别为 7.85 与 13.35 秒。
intro.en: T2VA denoising took 384.47 s and Ref2VA 654.10 s; mean step times were 7.85 s and 13.35 s respectively.

notes.zh: Ref2VA 比 T2VA 去噪多 269.63 秒；素材编码合计约 3.7 秒。
notes.en: Ref2VA adds 269.63 s of denoising over T2VA; media encoding totals about 3.7 s.

notes.zh: 不得把约 312 秒的端到端差值都归因于参考素材编码。
notes.en: Do not attribute the roughly 312 s end-to-end difference to reference encoding.

heading.zh: 结果绑定到补丁版本与单次启动环境
heading.en: Results are tied to the patched version and one startup

intro.zh: 运行使用 SGLang 0.5.18 与 PPU 适配补丁，4 卡，TP2×Ulysses2。每种任务丢弃 1 条 warmup 后记录 10 个有效串行样本。
intro.en: The run used SGLang 0.5.18 with PPU adaptation patches, four cards, TP2×Ulysses2. Ten valid serial samples were collected per task after one warmup was discarded.

notes.zh: 跨启动复现未做；该次启动内的窄范围不能替代重复启动测试。
notes.en: Cross-startup reproducibility was not tested; a narrow range within one startup is not a substitute.

notes.zh: 音频参考编码路径有额外补丁，未在其他平台交叉验证。
notes.en: The audio-reference encoding path uses an additional patch that was not cross-validated on another platform.

notes.zh: 内部节点、私有镜像及集群路径已脱敏。
notes.en: Internal node, private image, and cluster path details are redacted.

methodIntro.zh: 分别展示 T2VA 与 Ref2VA 的任务耗时和去噪阶段耗时，避免将素材编码耗时误归因到主循环。
methodIntro.en: T2VA and Ref2VA end-to-end and denoising times are shown separately to avoid attributing media encoding to the main loop.

methodNotes.zh: 视频生成耗时不使用 tok/s 表示。
methodNotes.en: Video generation time is reported in seconds, not tok/s.

methodNotes.zh: 公开版本删除集群内部标识和私有路径。
methodNotes.en: Internal cluster identifiers and private paths are removed from the public version.
